page_accounting.instruction: Do not discard unassigned pages. Inspect and classify them as blank, separator, appendix, or other source material before final completion.

completeness_rules: Every one of the 123 physical PDF pages must have a ledger entry, including cover, contents, separators and final page.
Every printed textbook page must be assigned to a part, lesson, appendix or explicitly classified non-content page.
Preserve original Japanese text and supplied furigana; do not silently shorten tables, warnings, examples, labels or numbered steps.
Each source content unit must contain Japanese, Romaji, English and Sinhala.
Map images only after visual comparison with the original PDF page.
A part is complete only after source-page coverage and translation audit pass.
